sources.title: Zhangjiajie Yellow Dragon Cave: How to Visit & What to See
sources.content:
Yellow Dragon Cave is recognized as the wonder of the world's caves and one of China's largest karst cave complexes. Total cave extends 7 km, with only a portion open to visitors. Highest point reaches 140 meters.

Hours: November-February 8:00-17:00; March-October 8:00-17:30
Duration: Plan 2-3 hours
Admission: CNY 118 (discounts for under 18 and over 60)

What to See:
Part 1 - Descent & Stone Halls (30-40 min): Massive chambers with colorful lighting. Dragon Dance Palace and Golden and Silver Ancient Weapons.
Part 2 - Underground River Cruise (8-10 min): 800-meter boat ride through Xiangshui River where giant salamanders lurk.
Part 3 - Grand Formations (40-50 min): Dragon Palace 14,000 sqm chamber with 1,700+ stalagmites. Sea-suppressing Needle at 19+ meters, China's tallest stalagmite. Fairy Waterfall at 40 meters, China's largest limestone waterfall group.
Final Section - The Climb Out (30 min): Hundred-Step Cloud Ladder, most physically demanding.

What to Wear: Cave constant 15°C (59°F). Wear strong grip shoes. Summer visitors bring long-sleeved jacket.

Important: No phone signal inside. No restrooms within cave. Bring water and snacks. Watch head clearance. One-way route with no turning back.

Crowd Management: Visit right after lunch (1:00-2:00 PM) or at opening (8:00-9:00 AM).

Transportation: Located 8 km east of Wulingyuan. Taxi under CNY 20 (15 min). Bus CNY 3 but 30+ minutes.

Baofeng Lake (8 km away) is a perfect half-day combo.

sources.title: Yellow Dragon Cave, Huanglong Cave Zhangjiajie
sources.content: Yellow Dragon Cave (Huanglong Cave) is known as the wonder of the world's caves and one of China's largest karst cave complexes. Total length 7,640 meters with maximum vertical height of 140 meters. Be prepared for 900+ stairs and 2 hours of walking. If you have limited mobility or knee problems, consider alternative attractions. The path gets slippery in places.

sources.title: Zhangjiajie Yellow Dragon Cave Scenic Area Guide
sources.content: Yellow Dragon Cave scenic area guide for Zhangjiajie. The cave features four floors with stalactites, stalagmites, underground rivers, lakes, and waterfalls. The Sea-Calming Needle stalagmite rises 19.2 meters with a 10 cm diameter at its thinnest. The cave maintains a constant temperature year-round.

sources.title: Yellow Dragon Cave, Huanglongdong Karst Cave, Zhangjiajie
sources.content: Yellow Dragon Cave (Huanglongdong) is a major karst cave in Zhangjiajie. Features multiple chambers connected by underground rivers. The cave tour includes a boat ride and walking sections. Key formations include the Dragon King's Throne and the Fairy Waterfall. Constant temperature of 16°C inside.

sources.title: Yellow Dragon Cave: Top Highlights, Tips, and Easy Routes
sources.content: Yellow Dragon Cave top highlights, tips, and easy routes to explore. The cave is one of the most impressive karst caves in China. Recommended to visit before entering the cave to use restrooms. No cell phone signal and limited light inside. Keep with your group to avoid getting separated. Works best as a half-day attraction.

sources.title: 黄龙洞_百度百科
sources.content:
黄龙洞旅游区位于湖南省张家界市武陵源境内，是世界溶洞奇观。1984年10月1日正式对外开放。

位置：湖南省张家界市武陵源区索溪峪镇河口村
距离：距张家界市城区36千米
洞内恒温：16-18摄氏度

洞穴规模：已探明洞底面积10万平方米，全长7.5千米，垂直高度140米。上下四层，包含1库、2河、3潭、4瀑、13大厅、98廊。近万根石笋、上千个白玉池。

主要景点：
龙宫：最大最古老厅堂，石笋1705余根
定海神针：最高石笋高19.2米，已投保1亿元
龙王宝座：最粗壮石笋高12米
万年雪松：高17米，年龄9.6万年
响水河：地下阴河全长2820米，游览800米约8分钟
天仙水瀑布：落差27.3米
千丘田：流石坝景观

生态广场面积11.92万平方米，投资超2亿元。包含黄龙音乐厅等十大景观区。

烟雨张家界：全国首台新民族原生态音乐秀。黄龙音乐季：2016年创办。

门票：溶洞60元/人，游船36元/人，语音讲解25元/人
开放时间：旺季（3-11月）8:00-18:00；淡季（12-2月）8:30-17:30
交通：武陵源汽车站乘1路公交直达，免费停车场

荣誉：2001年国家首批AAAA级旅游景区，2005年被评选为中国最美旅游溶洞。

sources.title: Yellow Dragon Cave - Zhangjiajie Travel Guide
sources.content: Yellow Dragon Cave travel guide for Zhangjiajie. The cave is one of the top attractions outside the national forest park. Features impressive stalactites and stalagmites, underground rivers, and a boat ride. The tour lasts about 2 hours. Constant temperature makes it a good rainy-day activity. Located near Wulingyuan town, easily combined with Baofeng Lake.
